    if (!visible || detailView) return;
    const now = data?.as_of || seconds();
    for (const p of data?.pulses || []) {
      const lastKey = `alerted-reason:${p.id}`;
      const previous = ctx.storage.get(lastKey, null);
      const reason = p.alert?.active ? p.alert.reason : null;
      if (previous && previous !== reason) {
        const key = `alerted:${p.id}:${previous}`;
        const old = ctx.storage.get(key, {});
        ctx.storage.set(key, { ...old, active: false });
      }
      ctx.storage.set(lastKey, reason);
      if (!reason) continue;
      const key = `alerted:${p.id}:${reason}`;
      const old = ctx.storage.get(key, {});
      const notify = ["toast", "os", "pet"].includes(p.alert.notify);
      const fire =
        notify && !old.active && (old.at == null || now - old.at >= 1800);
      // Store before notifying: multiple views share the same deduplication gate.
      ctx.storage.set(key, { active: true, at: fire ? now : old.at });
      if (fire)
        host.notify({ kind: "warning", message: `${p.title}: ${reason}` });
    }
